leads.name: Ginkgo of the Casa do Passadico garden
leads.why: Named in a 2008-01-13 comment on the Dias com Arvores post 'Alerta amarelo' (dias-com-arvores.blogspot.com/2005/12/alerta-amarelo.html), by an anonymous commenter arguing it is a finer specimen than Porto's Rainha das Virtudes: 'in the garden of Casa do Passadico, opposite the famous frying pans', a landmark they detour past regularly. The frying pans are Frigideiras do Cantinho on Largo de Sao Joao do Souto, which places the garden in the historic centre. Two things to settle before this can ever ship, and the second is the one that decides it: no second source and no coordinates yet, and Casa do Passadico is a private house, so hard rule 10 applies unless the garden is genuinely open to visitors. A tree behind a wall is not a place we send anybody.
